name: Father Cassidy
role: Catholic priest from Mandan, later of Jamestown
bio: Father Cassidy of Mandan visited George Fitzgerald in April 1884 and in May said mass in Medora, planning to return every two or three weeks. By July 1884 Father Martin had taken his place at Mandan and he had charge of the Jamestown parish.
mentions: Father Cassidy, of Mandan, is visiting Geo. Fitzgerald.
Father Cassidy, of Mandan, held mass here Tuesday morning. Hereafter he expects to be here every two or three weeks.
…day morning at Geo. Fitzgerald's, and Wednesday morning at the Marquis' residence. Father Martin takes Father Cassidy's place at Mandan, the latter now having charge of the Jamestown parish.
